description: Scrape RentCafe.com apartment listings for a city, with an optional bedroom/price/amenity filter and client-side rating/price/pet-friendly refinement.

filter.description: RentCafe supports one filter segment per search page. Pick the axis that matters most; use Min/Max price and Pet-friendly only below for extra client-side refinement on top of it.
filter.title: Listing filter

location.description: City as it appears on RentCafe, e.g. `austin-tx`, `Austin, TX`, or `new-york-city-ny`. Spaces/commas are auto-converted to the RentCafe URL slug.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Note: RentCafe itself only surfaces up to roughly 500 listings per location/filter combination (even for the largest cities); very large values are safe to set but a single location will rarely return more than ~500.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPrice.description: Drop listings whose highest advertised starting price is above this.
maxPrice.title: Max price ($/month)

minPrice.description: Drop listings whose lowest advertised starting price is below this.
minPrice.title: Min price ($/month)

minRating.description: Drop listings whose review rating is below this (client-side; RentCafe has no rating filter of its own).
minRating.title: Min rating (0-5)

petFriendlyOnly.description: Only emit listings whose amenity summary mentions "Pet friendly".
petFriendlyOnly.title: Pet friendly only

title: RentCafe Scraper Input
